fields.title: Polka: eleven recipients instead of six
fields.summary: Inventory found 11 external data recipients instead of the six known ones.
fields.decisionPrompt: What do we do? State the price of your decision.
fields.brief/role: You are a product manager at Polka.
fields.brief/company: Polka is a fictional grocery delivery service from local stores: 900 partner stores, a buyer app, and a partner dashboard.
fields.brief/context: You are a product manager at Polka. Ahead of a corporate deal, lawyers requested a list of sub-processors. An inventory revealed 11 external data recipients instead of the six that were known.
fields.brief/objective: Provide the client with a list that raises no new questions and eliminate unnecessary data sharing.
fields.brief/constraints: The list is needed for the deal. It is safer to remove integrations before signing than after.
fields.brief/task: Decide what you are doing and what will be included in the list.
fields.learnTakeaway/title: Remove the unnecessary first, then formalize
fields.learnTakeaway/body: A list of sub-processors is an acknowledgment that every data transfer is justified. Therefore, inventory starts with the question "why" rather than "how to document": usually, you find an integration left over from a completed experiment and a service that collects more than necessary for its intended use. Documenting unnecessary things costs more than deleting them, and a list of eleven inherently raises questions.
fields.evidenceCards/0/content: Payment provider, delivery service, SMS, analytics, AI provider, mapping.
fields.evidenceCards/1/content: Crash analytics (device ID, model, OS version), push notification service (token, ID), address verification service (full address including apartment), ad pixel in web version (behavior, ID), session recording service in web version (records user actions on screen).
fields.evidenceCards/2/content: Installed two years ago for an experiment, the experiment ended, the pixel remained.
fields.evidenceCards/3/content: Records everything, including form inputs. Used by designers roughly once a quarter.
fields.decisionOptions/0/label: Formalize the list of 11, sign missing DPAs
fields.decisionOptions/0/description: Formalize the list of 11, sign missing DPAs. Two weeks.
fields.decisionOptions/0/consequence: technically closes the question. Leaves the ad pixel and session recording in place, meaning data sharing without a real necessity. A list of 11 will automatically raise questions from the client's security team.
fields.decisionOptions/1/label: Remove unnecessary items, then formalize the rest
fields.decisionOptions/1/description: Remove unnecessary items, then formalize the rest. One and a half weeks.
fields.decisionOptions/1/consequence: ad pixel is removed—experiment is over. Session recording is reviewed: used once a quarter, records form inputs. Full address in verification service shortened to street and building. List reduced to 8-9 items.
fields.decisionOptions/2/label: Remove unnecessary, formalize, plus automated check of sent fields
fields.decisionOptions/2/description: Remove unnecessary, formalize, plus automated check of sent fields. Three weeks.
fields.decisionOptions/2/consequence: prevents both current and future accumulation. Misses the deadline for the list, but the list can be submitted earlier.
fields.decisionOptions/3/label: Deliver the list of the six known recipients
fields.decisionOptions/3/description: One day. Send the client's lawyers the list of six recipients known prior to the inventory.
fields.decisionOptions/3/consequence: an incomplete list in the document for the client's security team. Will be discovered during the very first technical audit.
fields.rubric/remediation/0/gap: Does not apply minimization before formalizing
fields.rubric/remediation/1/gap: Does not maintain an inventory of recipients
fields.rubric/remediation/2/gap: Does not control the composition of sent data
fields.rubric/remediation/3/gap: Boundaries for sending data to the AI provider are not defined
fields.rubric/remediation/4/gap: Fails to ask what data can be avoided collecting altogether
